title: Plugin prompts
description: Copyable prompts shown on the plugin's screen so someone running a system can paste them into a web or local agent to diagnose or do something with the plugin. {{placeholders}} are filled by the dashboard; unknown ones are left as-is.

kind.description: diagnose prompts are offered next to the health chip when the plugin has warnings or errors.

when.description: Human hint for when to use it.

skill.description: A skill this prompt relies on; the screen links to it.

prompt.description: Placeholders: {{plugin.id}}, {{plugin.version}}, {{haxcms.version}}, {{runtime}}, {{scope}}, {{status}}, {{requirements}}, {{log}} (recent entries for this plugin, secrets never included).

mcp.description: Offer this prompt through the MCP plugin's prompts feature when it is enabled.
